scope: Exact seed1 replication of frozen 14.99M Regression; unchanged recipe, masks and 30k budget
learning_rate_recipe: exact original three-stage recipe: warm100+cosine2e-4 to4e-5 at2000; constant4e-5 to10000; recover to8e-5 at11000; cosine to1e-5 at30000
area_replacement: expand by one pixel in the same quadrant as each inserted visible slit; exact quadrant missing counts; remove five corner pixels from each condition to reach 1638

foreground_quadrant_caliper.role: diagnostic only; total quadrant mask counts are exactly matched

unsupported_images: exclude symmetrically before training; require at least 80 percent of original train and dev images retained; no model outcomes used
training_flip: flip image and its paired masks together to preserve foreground matching
primary_contrast: Regression LPIPS minus FM LPIPS; FM masked sample PSNR minus Regression PSNR; fixed30k, Regression1 vs FM8
support_criterion: user removed minimum-effect threshold: report any positive mean improvement, uncertainty separately; joint improvement means LPIPS decreases and PSNR increases in equal-weight average of the two geometries; always report each geometry and any tradeoff
evaluation: same124 dev images, four frozen matched-mask pairs/image; Regression deterministic output versus FM existing four-sample average; image-paired bootstrap after averaging mask pairs
limitations: this run is seed1; aggregate with the frozen seed0; no automatic extra seeds or training extension
reused development images; no official test access
same updates and architecture do not equal inference cost; Regression1 vs FM8
different training objectives and time inputs; raw losses are not cross-comparable
inherited v4 common-support and approximate foreground matching limitations
image bootstrap does not measure training-seed variation; no minimum effect threshold
candidate_selection: sample uniformly among the 32 eligible candidates with smallest summed normalized core/possible/head count differences; ties shuffled by mask selection seed
annotation_only_design_audit: 39x42 with 2-pixel gaps rejected for insufficient support; 31x53 with 1-pixel gaps at 16px/2% retained 96/128 train-probe and 86/128 dev; 32px/3% retained 124/128 in each; design frozen before any new-model outcomes
training_objective: masked direct image MSE in [-1,1]; z=y, t=0, target=x
